2608.11705.title: Making Your LLMs More Objective: Stabilizing LLM Safety Behavior Across Traits with Trait-Invariant Safety Tuning
2608.11705.paper_summary: Aligned large language models (LLMs) are expected to exhibit safety behavior based on the content of the user request: they should refuse unsafe requests and comply with safe ones. However, we show that the same request can elicit substantially different safety decisions under different traits assigned in the system prompt, a failure mode we call trait-induced safety variation. To measure this failure, we introduce refusal-based metrics: Trait-Induced Deviation measures dataset-level deviation from the no-trait baseline, while Trait-Induced Flip Rate measures whether the same request receives different safety decisions across traits. We then provide a representation-level analysis of the mechanism behind trait-induced safety shifts and find that traits perturb the model's safety representations within a low-dimensional subspace. To achieve trait-invariant safety, where safety behavior remains stable across traits, we introduce Trait-Invariant Safety Tuning (TIST), a simple yet effective self-distillation framework that aligns an LLM's trait-conditioned behavior with its no-trait behavior. Guided by our analysis, we further propose Trait-Subspace Neutralization (TraSN), an instantiation of TIST, which enforces invariance only within the identified trait subspace. Experiments show that TraSN improves trait-invariant safety and strengthens harmful-request safety while preserving general capability. Our results highlight traits as an important factor in LLM safety and robust model behavior.
2608.11705.paper_summary_zh: 對齊的大型語言模型（LLMs）預期會根據用戶請求的內容展現安全行為：它們應該拒絕不安全的請求並遵從安全的請求。然而，我們顯示相同的請求在系統提示中分配不同特徵時可能引發實質上不同的安全決策，這是一種我們稱之為特徵引起的安全變異的失效模式。為了測量這一失效，我們引入了基於拒絕的指標：特徵引起的偏差測量數據集層級的偏差，與無特徵基線相比，而特徵引起的翻轉率則測量相同請求在不同特徵下是否收到不同的安全決策。接著，我們提供了特徵引起的安全變化背後機制的表示層級分析，發現特徵在低維子空間內擾動模型的安全表示。為了實現特徵不變的安全，即安全行為在不同特徵間保持穩定，我們引入了特徵不變安全調整（TIST），這是一個簡單而有效的自我蒸餾框架，將LLM的特徵條件行為與其無特徵行為對齊。在我們的分析指導下，我們進一步提出了特徵子空間中和（TraSN），這是TIST的一個實例，僅在識別的特徵子空間內強制不變性。實驗顯示TraSN改善了特徵不變的安全性，並加強了對有害請求的安全性，同時保持一般能力。我們的結果強調特徵是LLM安全性和穩健模型行為的重要因素。
2608.11705.author: Lang Cao et.al.
